notes.title: UPDATE - 0.965 Leap Motion Support
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31102684/8be5dbcb82200a54fda102d8ed228af2497882c0.jpg[/img]

In this update I addressed the issues with Leap Motion support, and added Leap Motion support to the menu screen as well. You can use Leap Motion in combination with tracking controllers, or by itself. At this point you do not have a flashlight unless you are using a tracking controller.

There were also some minor performance improvements, and some small modifications to the UI and improvements to the VR device detection. 

So Leap Motion fans, give it a try, and feel free to leave feedback in the forum! ː2017meatballː


[URL=http://steamcommunity.com/app/737260/discussions/0/1488866180617792100/]Official Suggestion Thread[/url]

notes.title: UPDATE - 0.964 Steam Achievements and More!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31102684/b742cf353aed01757a9c445d417c8757a0e0ad28.jpg[/img]

This is a big update! Coaster of Carnage VR is now fully integrated with Steamworks API and the first achievement is available now to unlock! 

I also increased the total track length, and increased the overall height, for a faster more exciting ride.

Mother spider ːMH_Spiderː now has a cozy little home built, complete with a food pantry. 

There were some minor improvements to SFX and overall performance.

There is still some work to be done on the coaster path animation, but that will be in another update.

Happy New Year everyone!

notes.title: UPDATE - 0.963 Reorient View Using 'R' Key
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31102684/5742f6228bd3830a3c1661c535a67098594e9a95.jpg[/img]

There are a few big changes in this update. The most significant is the ability for Vive users to reorient your view using the 'R' key. Use this to help position yourself into the seat of the coaster properly! 

Also another significant update, Coaster of Carnage VR is now integrated with the Steamworks API. You'll notice that if you are logged into Steam, your username is now displayed at the top of the menu screen. If you are not logged into Steam, a notice will be displayed in place of your username. 

App now detects whether you are using OVR or OpenVR. This is a step in the right direction to get everything working great on the Oculus Rift!

The chaperone boundaries have been removed from the menu screen. I don't think they are necessary seeing as this is intended to be a seated game, and it was just clunky looking and in the way.

Other than that there were some minor performance improvements.

Happy Solstice!  ː2015hollyː

edit: PS I am currently experimenting with Achievements. The current Achievement that you see is not fully setup yet, and you cannot earn this Achievement just yet!

[URL=http://steamcommunity.com/app/737260/discussions/0/1488866180617792100/]Official Suggestion Thread[/url]

notes.title: UPDATE - 0.961 Improved Rift Support / Arachnophobia
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31102684/d3a7ee430581c25c699a0db0ef9c27d1506daef0.jpg[/img]

In this update I added the ability to play the game by hitting the 'Enter' key on the keyboard so that those users without a Vive controller can now get past the menu screen. This should (experimental!) make it so that Oculus Rift players can play the application even though they will not have hands yet at this point.

 [Spoiler Alert]

Also I added the mother spider! ːMH_Spiderː Thanks for the suggestion fishhead420!  I will be doing work on the mother spider in future updates, giving her a bit more life, but for now this little addition should add to the fright factor for anyone with an ounce of arachnophobia.

Also made some other minor updates, such as improved spider 2's animation path, and some UI changes.

[URL=http://steamcommunity.com/app/737260/discussions/0/1488866180617792100/]Official Suggestion Thread[/url]
